1: All this, whatever moves (living or lifeless) in the moving (world), is enveloped by the Lord.
Find enjoyment in renunciation; do not covet what belongs to others.
Desiring nothing else, one might live for a hundred years; work therewith thus is not stained by evil.
2: [Isha 5-7 — The Self moves and moves not]
It moves, it moves not; it is far, and it is near; it is within all this, and it is outside of all this.
And he who beholds all beings in the Self, and the Self in all beings, he never turns away from it.
When to a man who understands, the Self has become all things, what sorrow, what trouble can there be to him who once beheld that unity?
